name: Pinecone
shortInfo: Vector storage and search for AI applications.
brief: Pinecone is a vector database that enables scalable similarity search and retrieval for AI, machine learning, and real-time applications.
about:
Pinecone Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to Pinecone Vector Database in an automated manner.

Check more about api documentation [here](https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/2024-07/data-plane/upsert).
availableSync:
[Export](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/pinecone/syncs/upsert-data.html)

This sync can be used to load data from a user specified data warehouse to the Pinecone vector database.
